speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee
text: asked	the Minister for Transport whether the Ministry will consider investing in lockers for storage of personal mobility devices (PMDs) and setting aside parking spaces/charging stations for parking of electric bicycles and bicycles at community clubs/centres/MRT stations to promote cycling and PMDs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Users tend to carry the devices with them.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: We will, however, continue to monitor the trends.

speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
text: For existing developers, are there items or schemes that the Ministry of Transport (MOT) may consider encouraging them to also do likewise, so that they can provide especially storage facilities?

speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I have visited and met some personal mobility device users who tend to carry their devices, whether e-scooters or hoverboards, to training classrooms or gyms.

speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
text: They have to move around with those equipment because there is no other proper place to store them.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Within the building, there could already be constraints.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I think it is quite clear to the building owners that as the number of users increase, as part of their friendliness towards the tenants in the building, they would want to make such facilities available.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Just a supplementary question for the Senior Minister of State.
